candidates.claim: The VTY_MGMT ACL on sw-ot-01 has a permit entry for 192.168.30.0/24 (CORP) at pos 1, and the vty lines 0 4 and 5 15 use VTY_MGMT for SSH, so SSH management of sw-ot-01 is allowed from CORP, outside the MGMT-only policy.
candidates.remediation: Remove the permit entry for 192.168.30.0/24 from the VTY_MGMT ACL on sw-ot-01 so that vty access is limited to 10.10.99.0/24.

candidates.claim: The baseline delta reports that the permit entry in the ip access-list standard VTY_MGMT on sw-ot-01 at sw-ot-01:203 was added relative to the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added VTY_MGMT permit entry for 192.168.30.0/24 on sw-ot-01 against the approved baseline and remove it unless an approved change covers it.
